scope: Actual production native recording/owner with controlled media clock and events. No physical Android, decoder or audibility claim.

tests.name: Actual playRecording forwards the exact progress callback and source key to native playback
Accepted media clock reports playing, timeupdate, seeked, duration and rate unchanged
Real pause and resumed playing report the same source without observer playback requests
Hidden and visible observations read the actual media position; no wall-clock interpolation
No accepted playing event means no progress, even with metadata, pause and visibility events
Stale caller-token cannot deliver a native clock sample
Stale prepare-sequence cannot deliver a native clock sample
Stale session-membership cannot deliver a native clock sample
Stale finish-handler cannot deliver a native clock sample
Stale lease cannot deliver a native clock sample
Completed attempt removes all progress listeners and a retained callback remains inert
Reused audio element rejects old attempt callbacks while the new one alone reports
Adding the observer introduces no extra timers, seeks, storage writes or play requests
